description: This file defines the feature for deleting comments within an ASP.NET Core application following the CQRS pattern. It includes a command class, a validator for the command, and a request handler that interacts with the database context to remove a comment based on a slug and comment ID.

classes.name: Delete.Command
classes.description: Represents the command to delete a comment identified by a slug and comment ID.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the delete command, ensuring the Slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the delete comment request by locating the article and comment, then removing the comment from the database.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the deletion process: retrieves the article, locates the comment, and removes it.
